findings.source_passage: the enormous cutting tackles, among other ponderous things comprising a cluster of blocks generally painted green, and which no single man can possibly lift—this vast bunch of grapes was swayed up
findings.why_it_matters: The 'vast bunch of grapes' simile is a characteristically Melvillean conceit—whimsical, concrete, and voice-establishing—that the draft discards entirely, leaving only functional machinery description.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the 'vast bunch of grapes' image: e.g., 'the enormous cluster of blocks—green-painted, too heavy for one man—this vast bunch of grapes was swayed to the main-top.'

findings.source_passage: every bolt in her starts like the nail-heads of an old house in frosty weather; she trembles, quivers, and nods her frighted mast-heads to the sky
findings.why_it_matters: The simile of bolt-heads in a frost-cracked house is a distinctive, texture-rich figure that individualizes the moment; the draft retains only 'bolts started' and 'nodded her mast-heads,' losing both the simile and 'trembles, quivers.'
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the nail-head simile and the triad 'trembles, quivers, and nods her frighted mast-heads' to preserve the prosodic and imagistic signature.

findings.source_passage: all hands swearing occasionally, by way of assuaging the general friction
findings.why_it_matters: Melville's ironic formula—oaths as a technical lubricant for 'general friction'—is a dry comic climax to the chapter. The draft's 'oaths to oil the friction' approximates it but softens the deadpan register ('by way of assuaging') that is the whole joke.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore verbatim or near-verbatim: 'all hands swearing occasionally, by way of assuaging the general friction.'

findings.source_passage: into an unfurnished parlor called the blubber-room. Into this twilight apartment sundry nimble hands keep coiling away
findings.why_it_matters: The mock-domestic framing ('unfurnished parlor,' 'twilight apartment') is characteristic Melvillean architectural irony; the draft drops both epithets, retaining only the functional action.
findings.suggested_fix: Reintroduce at least 'unfurnished parlor called the blubber-room' and 'twilight apartment' to preserve the ironic domestication of the whale-ship interior.

summary: No high-severity signature losses; three medium-severity flattening failures (the 'vast bunch of grapes' simile, the frost-nail-head simile with its triad, and the closing oaths-as-lubricant formula) thin the chapter's voice but do not reach the regeneration threshold.
